_about: #294's tone lines, inferred from each brief's Aesthetic and Client values words and the project's rules file, never from a render. runner.py packets writes each packet's brief-tone.md from them (tone_brief).

mmm1.brief: the range the five directions sit inside. Energy calm (Client values 2 and 4: calm first, not busy). Weight light to middle (Client values 6: confident without big-firm claims; inferred). Warmth middle to warm and soft (Client values 1: personal and approachable; inferred). Order ordered (Client values 4 and 9: not busy, survives a lay editor). Familiarity typical of the category to middle (Client values 5: a marketing vehicle, not a campaign; inferred).

cards.v1 Legal pad: energy calm (Client values 2). Weight light (ballpoint ink on paper; inferred). Warmth warm and soft (canary paper and Mark's hand; inferred). Order middle (a ruled pad and one handwritten note per view; inferred). Familiarity novel, outside the range: Client values 10 puts Mark's legal pad on the table.
cards.v2 General arrangement: energy middle, outside the range: Client values 10 puts Mark's blueprint paper on the table, and its diazo ground and one amber band are louder than calm. Weight middle (inferred). Warmth cool and hard (an engineer's section sheet; inferred). Order ordered (a title block and a sheet's grid; inferred). Familiarity novel, outside the range, by the same Client values 10.
cards.v3 Inscription: energy calm (Client values 2). Weight heavy, outside the range: the aqueduct's own stone and carved capitals, tested as the literal reading of the brand (inferred). Warmth cool and hard (grey granite, square capitals, hard edges; inferred). Order ordered (a fixed three-colour palette, one accent; inferred). Familiarity novel, outside the range, as the one literal direction (inferred).
cards.v4 Water: energy calm (Client values 2). Weight middle (inferred). Warmth middle (a muted river green; inferred). Order ordered (one hue, one photograph, one line; Client values 4). Familiarity middle (Client values 10: Mark's muted colour).
cards.v5 House colours: energy calm (Client values 2 and 4). Weight light (a true white page, generous margins; inferred). Warmth middle (the logo's blue and grey; inferred). Order ordered (nothing in a panel; Client values 4). Familiarity typical of the category (Client values 5; inferred).

mmm2.brief: the range the seven directions sit inside. Energy calm to middle (Client values 2, calm first, against the founder's "alive, not boring"). Weight light (the founder's "refined, never childish"; inferred). Warmth middle (the house blue and grey, on a warm paper ground: research b). Order ordered (a ground, an ink and at most one accent: research a.2; Client values 4). Familiarity typical of the category to middle ("reflects what Mark does", yet not "a look any consultancy could own").
